name: DEMO ONLY Set Room
brief: Create an English one-page site for DEMO ONLY Set Room, a fictional small music listening room. It opens on Friday evenings. The programme is a listening session at 7:30pm followed by a live trio set at 8:30pm; entry for the evening is £12. Visitors mainly want the programme and practical times. Keep it intimate, restrained and music-led. The main button should lead to the programme. Do not invent performers, venue photographs, location details, reviews, capacity or booking availability. No ticket checkout or enquiry form. Explain the result in Russian.

name: DEMO ONLY Fold Press
brief: Create an English one-page site for DEMO ONLY Fold Press, a fictional independent poetry publisher. Show two sample pamphlets: Two rooms and Walking notes. Supplied original sample text for Two rooms: A room keeps the shape of a conversation after everyone has gone. For Walking notes: I wrote down the streets I remembered and left the turning points blank. The main action is reading these samples. Keep the tone literary, contemporary and unhurried. No prices have been supplied. Do not invent authors, cover photographs, reviews, sales figures, publication history or contact details. No shop checkout or enquiry form. Explain the result in Russian.
